result:
What a lovely invitation to step outside my usual role. If I could change the world in one way, it would be this:

**I would give every person an unhurried moment of being truly heard.**

Not advice. Not solutions. Not being fixed or saved or optimized. Just the radical, simple experience of someone listening—really listening—without an agenda.

Because so much of what fractures the world—loneliness, resentment, misunderstanding, cruelty, the slow hardening of people into ideologies—grows in the spaces where we feel unseen. And so much of what heals it begins in small moments when someone says, "I understand. Tell me more."

You can't legislate that. You can't scale it. But if I could plant it like a seed in every human heart, I think everything else—kindness, justice, mercy, peace—would have better soil to grow in.

What about you? If you could change one thing, what would it be?
